import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, q = data[0], data[1]
    values = [0] + data[2:2 + n]
    tree = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        tree[i] += values[i]
        parent = i + (i & -i)
        if parent <= n:
            tree[parent] += tree[i]

    pos = 2 + n
    output = []

    for _ in range(q):
        event = data[pos]
        k = data[pos + 1]
        pos += 2

        if event == 0:
            p = data[pos]
            pos += 1
            delta = p - values[k]
            values[k] = p
            i = k
            while i <= n:
                tree[i] += delta
                i += i & -i
        else:
            total = 0
            i = k
            while i > 0:
                total += tree[i]
                i -= i & -i
            output.append(str(total))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(output))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
